column1: # Benchmark 9's community, written out in full: 10 genomes, nine known in GTDB r207
# and one whose species is new in r214 -- and the novel one is the second most
# abundant member of the community. Coverage and truth taxonomy are stated here
# rather than looked up in the GTDB metadata, because the novel genome has no r207
# metadata row -- see ../rules/data_generation_community.smk.
# role: known    = species present in every r207 database; truth is the full species
#       novel    = species new in r214 (genus known); truth stops at genus
# Unlike benchmark 8 the coverages are not round: they come from a marine relative-
# abundance draw, which is why the nine known members sit in a narrow 1.3x-27.6x band
# while the unknown is carried at 10.2x. Because those nine are ordinary known species
# comfortably above the marker-gene floor, any species-level loss is attributable to
# the one unknown rather than to sensitivity.
# Reads for the nine known genomes come from ../reference_genomes/shadow (the Zenodo
# shadow pool, gathered by ../gather_tool_databases.smk); the novel one is downloaded
# from NCBI by that same file's bench89_novel_genomes_download rule.
# Provenance: this file was reconstructed from the reads of the original run, whose
# per-genome origin is recoverable from the ART read names (each is
# <source contig>-<index>). Every known genome's taxonomy is its r207 GTDB lineage,
# every coverage here is within 3% of the reads*2*150/genome_length measured from
# those reads (ART under-delivers slightly, since a fragment cannot straddle a contig
# end, so fragmented assemblies lose the most), and the truth this file produces
# reproduces the recorded marine0.condensed exactly.
genome
